_comment: Copy to log-triage/config.json and edit. Drives scripts/collect-log-errors.mjs and the /log-triage command. The live config.json is gitignored. Multi-source: each entry in `sources` has a `type` and is bound to a `service` (the repo the fix is made in). Mirrors the orchestrator's sources[] convention.

query._comment_1: Global defaults applied to every source. `pattern` is the case-insensitive OR-list of error markers; cloud adapters push it server-side, file/command adapters filter client-side.
query._comment_2: lookback_hours: default window (override with --hours). limit: max lines per source. min_occurrences: drop clusters seen fewer times.

sources._comment: AWS CloudWatch Logs Insights. Needs the aws CLI + read-only logs:StartQuery/GetQueryResults. log_groups are EXACT names (aws logs describe-log-groups).
sources.name: orders-aws

sources._comment: Google Cloud Logging via the gcloud CLI. `filter` overrides the default severity>=ERROR + time-window filter.
sources.name: orders-gcp

sources._comment: Azure Monitor Log Analytics via the az CLI. `query` overrides the default KQL; table is used when query is omitted.
sources.name: orders-azure

sources._comment: Datadog Logs Search API. api_key_env/app_key_env name the env vars holding the keys (never the raw keys). `query` is Datadog log search syntax.
sources.name: orders-dd

sources._comment: Sentry issues API (each unresolved issue = one clustered row). token_env names the env var with a Sentry auth token.
sources.name: orders-sentry

sources._comment: Grafana Loki query_range. `query` is a LogQL selector; set `tenant` for multi-tenant (X-Scope-OrgID).
sources.name: orders-loki

sources._comment: Elasticsearch / OpenSearch _search. api_key_env optional (Authorization: ApiKey). `query` overrides the auto-built DSL; timestamp_field/message_field name the source fields.
sources.name: orders-es

sources._comment: UNIVERSAL escape hatch — runs any shell command and parses its stdout. Works with ANY provider (kubectl logs, curl to an API, journalctl, etc.). format: lines | json | jsonl; timestamp_field/message_field apply to json/jsonl.
sources.name: any-provider

sources._comment: Local log files (plain lines or JSONL). `path` supports comma-separated paths and single-level * globs.
sources.name: local-app-log

services._comment: Repo binding for the fix step, referenced by source.service. One entry per service; multiple sources may point at the same service.
services.name: orders-service

defaults._comment_1: Applied to any service that doesn't override the field.
defaults._comment_2: assignee.github: handle to assign/request-review. assignee.email: dev notified (defaults to the Claude account email).

triage._comment_1: max_issues_per_run: how many top-ranked clusters to fix per run. Keep at 1 until trusted.
triage._comment_2: draft_prs: always open PRs as drafts. auto_fix false = report-only. confidence_floor: only clusters rated >= this get a code PR.

notifier._comment_1: How the assigned dev is told about a PR. github_review_request always fires.
notifier._comment_2: email.transport: 'gmail-mcp' for interactive runs; headless cron should use 'ses' or 'none'.
